text: On XXXX XXXX I submitted the information that XXXX requested. I had to buy a fax app to submit the information because their website did not work for the card. I spoke to 2 representatives again on XXXX XXXX trying to get a replacement card. They told me to upload information to their website which I tried numerous times and it would always give me an error. I explained that and they told me they cant fix the website so I would need to again pay to fax them the information. I told them Im not paying more money to send them information again about the card that they shut off and I paid for. I asked them to have someone call me back that could help me and they hung up.
